notes.title: New Steam Community Rewards!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, gamers![/h3]

[h3]We are excited to announce that thanks to your incredible activity and support, we have released new community items on Steam! You can now enjoy unique trading cards, beautiful backgrounds (including animated ones), cool emoticons, and stylish avatar frames.[/h3]

[h3]Now you can enjoy the game and earn these awesome goodies. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm![/h3]

[h3]Best regards,
Play & Cum 💦 Team[/h3]
